rows.en: It's no good! We won't make it! Aaagh!
rows.notes: Same line as MUF plus a scream at the end in the AF transcript (Whisper flagged nospeech/repeat); kept the scream as 'Aaagh!'. Drop it if the clip has none.

rows.en: Maybe it's because I got a girlfriend? Hahaha! Whoa!
rows.notes: Same as MUF plus a final 'uwaa' (clip is 0.9s longer than MUF): 'Whoa!'.
Transcript 'watashi ga de wo kiru' is garbled; read as MUF 'watashi ga deyou'.
Transcript is 'SEXY' (nonsense); read as MUF 'shutsugeki suru!'.

rows.en: Now then, shall I go stir things up?

rows.notes: Transcript 'sougou shatei' is a mishearing of MUF 'sou wa sasen!'.
Laughter (MUF hears 'hahaha'); Whisper wrote 'fooku'.
Kept MUF wording.

Both transcripts 'goshaka' (MUF gave no subtitle). Read as 'koshaku na!' (insolent), which fits the slot (other pilots' 006: reacting to being hit, 'Nice attack.'). If the clip is only a grunt, make it no_subtitle.
Transcript is a run of 'na'; read as MUF 'na, na, nani?'.
Scream.
AF transcript is clear 'kurae!' (MUF had none).
Grunt.
Shout/breath.
Roar.
Grunt (MUF 'uun'); Whisper wrote 'oopun'.
Hum/laugh 'fun fun fun'.
Grunt (MUF 'uun'); Whisper wrote 'eifosu'.

rows.en: I won't let you get away!
rows.notes: Both transcripts garbled ('nigasazu kara sa'); read as 'nigasan zo!', as MUF did.
Transcript 'batoru'; read as MUF 'baka me!'.

Both transcripts garbled ('renchuu doumei' / 'renchuu doudou'). Slot 100 is the operation-start line for every pilot. Guessed 'zengun shutsudou' (all forces, move out). MUF used 'Vrlitwhai, moving out.' Another candidate: 'seisei doudou' (fair and square). Needs a listen.

rows.en: So they dare to test us? Bold of them.
rows.notes: Both transcripts end 'ii joukyou da', which is ungrammatical after 'tamesu to wa'; read as the set phrase 'ii dokyou da' (bold/nervy). MUF had 'A fine chance to test our strength.' Took the enemy as the ones testing (stock battle-start line, nobody addressed directly).
Transcript 'yoshi yoshi yoshi' is likely Whisper repeating; read as MUF 'yoshi!'.
Hum/laugh 'fun fun'.
Transcript 'nigerareru zo' (you can escape) is a mishearing of 'nigerarenzo'; kept MUF.

rows.en: I won't let you get away!

rows.notes: Grunt.
Roar.

rows.en: You don't give up easily, do you?
rows.notes: Read 'ne wo ageru' with the homophone 'ne' (cry uncle), as 'nakanaka ne wo agen na': the enemy refuses to give in. Fits slot 109 (an enemy holding out: 'You're stubborn!', 'It's still alive?!') and the next rows ('Tenacious', 'Still want to fight?'). MUF had 'You've sharpened your skills, haven't you.'
AF adds 'na' to MUF 'shibutoi'.
AF transcript is only laughter; MUF clip (same length) heard 'fun fun... moroi'. Assumed the same line.
'tawai ma nai' read as 'tawai mo nai'.
AF 'arawarete maire' is ungrammatical; kept MUF 'arawareta na'. The AF clip is 0.3s longer and may add 'maire' (come at me).

rows.en: Come at me and I'll cut you down!
rows.notes: Transcript garbled; read as MUF 'kaeriuchi ni shite yaru'.

rows.en: Hmph. Is that the best you can do?
rows.notes: AF 'kono teido de', MUF 'kono teido ka'; kept MUF's meaning. If it really is 'de', the line trails off ('With only this...').
Laughter.

rows.en: Hm? My shield? Well, no matter.
rows.notes: AF transcript 'shiirudo wa mayoi de iru' is garbled; kept MUF 'shiirudo ga? maa yoi yoi'.

rows.en: Hmph. So my shield is gone.
rows.notes: AF adds 'fun fun fun' and 'ka' to MUF.
Grunting ('yoku yoku' / MUF 'eifosu'), no clear words.
Grunt (MUF 'n').

rows.en: This is nothing. I'm made differently from you lot.

rows.notes: AF 'paku paku', MUF 'baka baka'; kept MUF. Could also be 'baka na' (impossible).
Grunt.
Grunt.
Stutter kept.
'yarioru'.

rows.en: Is this as far as I go?

rows.notes: Glossary term.

rows.en: The enemy is quite capable too.
rows.notes: 'yariyori' read as 'yarioru'.

rows.en: You can still move, can't you?
rows.notes: AF 'mada ugoken na' (can't move), MUF 'mada ugokenai'. Read as 'mada ugokeru na', said to a partner: slot 140 is a check on a partner for every pilot ('Don't be reckless!'), and the next row is 'Are you all right?'. Same reading as MUF's English.
'okite kita' read as 'fuete kita', as MUF did.
'zouen kan' (reinforcement ships) misheard with the wrong kanji; kept MUF.

rows.en: Hm? I didn't call for reinforcements.
Friendly forces? Which unit is that?
rows.notes: AF 'yuuguu dono butai da' read as 'yuugun, dono butai da?' (friendly forces, which unit?). MUF heard 'yuugu dono kurai da' and wrote 'Reinforcements? How many?'. The AF reading is more coherent, but this may be the same recording.
'nukataga' read as 'nukatta ka'.
'onore'.
AF delivery has exclamations.

rows.en: The operation is a success. Well done.
rows.notes: 'yoku yatte iru da' read as 'yoku yatte kureta'.

rows.en: That's all. I'm calling off the operation!

rows.notes: AF transcript repeats 'ute', but the clip is the same length as MUF's single 'ute'; took the repeat as Whisper's.
AF 'shageki sentou kaishi' (begin ranged combat) matches the companion lines 166/168 (close combat). MUF split it as 'Open fire! Begin combat!'.
